name: AscensionLib
description: Pokemon progression for Cobblemon: every Pokemon gets a rarity and modifiers that change how it fights, grown with upgrades, a materials wallet, Uniques, Fusion and rare respec items. The shared library for CobbleRaids, CobbleTowers and ascensionDungeons. Server-side only: every screen is a web page shown by the WebGUI mod on the client. Battle effects act in the simulator when CobbleRaids is installed.
